final_answer: The computational security status of AES-256 encryption standard against brute-force attacks is considered to be very high. While theoretical attacks have been published that can recover the key of a reduced-round version of AES-256, these attacks are not considered practical due to their complexity and the vast key space of the full AES-256 algorithm. Quantum attacks are also not considered a threat to AES-256 due to its quantum resistance being similar to that of AES-128 against traditional attacks.
